alt_text: Per-session distributions show mean heart rate, RMSSD, and SDNN by canonical cohort. Stress Index, SNS Index, and PNS Index are unavailable in source exports and have no plotted values.
interpretation: Episodic heart-rate and HRV distributions provide session autonomic context and remain distinct from WHOOP overnight recovery HRV.
limitation: This is descriptive episodic/session physiology from Kubios/Polar H10. Session HRV is not WHOOP overnight recovery HRV, and unavailable indices are not imputed.
limitations: Sample counts, date coverage, source scope, missingness, and measurement availability accompany each scientific result.
long_description: Episodic heart-rate and HRV distributions provide session autonomic context and remain distinct from WHOOP overnight recovery HRV. Each dot is one available canonical episodic session; no missing value is estimated. n and missingness are reported separately for every metric and cohort. question: How are source-supported session heart-rate and autonomic metrics distributed across governed cohorts?
title: Available autonomic and heart-rate distributions
